model: U=sum_e (|r_i-r_j|²-l_e²)²/(8 l_e²); Ei=incident-contact average of the same fixed quartic edge energies; rigid modes removed
normalization: exact all-positive-mode harmonic SD of the SAME fixed quartic Ei, common to every physical matrix
controls: graph heat kernel at reciprocal first positive graph eigenvalue
ranking: receiver RMS, descending score, canonical position breaks ties; primary top5; rank percentile = average ascending rank / frozen candidate count
evaluation: Only after prediction files are frozen: sequence-map every resolved reference protein residue; distance of any resolved heavy atom to AY7 <=5Å is contact. PCG64 seed20260912,10000distinct draws unless <=100000configurations then enumerate exactly. No unknown in noncontact/null pools. paired_effects: Mean primary-minus-control percentile rank among eligible known contacts; ranks first fixed over all193prediction candidates; reuse identical matched label configurations. Raw conditional p values, exploratory and not independent target randomization. No global four-target claim.
success_interpretation: Report every result and threshold failure; no label-based tuning, no universal cutoffs, no biological efficacy/generalization/quantum advantage claim. Unverified nonfunctional pockets remain unresolved.
